name: Structure
covers: Keeps a codebase's shape as it grows: file length, layers that import downward, exports that are used and tested, and file names that say what they hold.

rules.title: Keep files at 500 lines or fewer

caught.text:
export const first = 1;

























































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































export const last = 2;

passes.text:
export const first = 1;
export const last = 2;

rules.title: Keep imports pointing down the layers

caught.text:
import { loadAccounts } from "@/app/accounts/page";

export const totals = loadAccounts;

passes.text:
import type { Account } from "@/app/accounts/page";

export const count = (accounts: Account[]) => accounts.length;

rules.title: Keep file names specific to what the code does
